authorization_history.effect: Remove the nine-dimensional representation and coefficient magnitude limits.

authorization_history.instruction: ok remove also the exterior requirement
authorization_history.effect: Remove exact matching to the reference exterior at r>=40m and the associated perturbation support restriction.

changed: No restriction to the nine original polynomial coefficients
No bound of 1/10 on representation coefficients
No requirement to preserve the original reference potential outside40m
No fixed exterior radius, transition extent or exterior decay profile

retained.theory: Classical general relativity with zero cosmological constant
retained.metric: ds^2=-du^2+|dq+grad(Phi)du|^2; u=ct; unit lapse and Euclidean spatial slices
retained.core: Phi and its required derivatives agree exactly with Phi0=2*x*g0(r) on r<=10m
retained.asymptotic_frame: grad(Phi) tends to2*e_x at spatial infinity, giving the original stationary comoving-to-asymptotic frame relation
retained.regularity: Phi is C5 and the metric C4
retained.objective: E_abs=integral_R3 |T(n,n)| d^3q, finite and counting the entire redesigned exterior

extent_policy: Every candidate must define its entire spatial geometry. No finite common bound on its exterior extent is imposed. An arbitrarily large support is a cost of a candidate, and is reported explicitly.
representation_policy: Candidates are fixed data, using exact rational parameters and elementary functions where applicable. Candidate data, evaluator, proof argument and evidence are separately inspectable. Original records remain unchanged.
comparison_scope: Comparisons concern the same energy functional and reference instance, in an explicitly enlarged admissible class. They do not contradict lower bounds whose hypotheses include the original decoder or exterior.
physical_scope: Prescribed stationary spacetime and its Einstein source. This contract makes no claim about material realization, formation energy, propulsion fuel, acceleration, quantum consistency, or the integral of all stresses.
